## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is based on the latest `main`.
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `chore:`, `docs:`).
- [ ] `composer test` passes locally (PHPUnit, PHPStan, PHP-CS-Fixer, PHPCS).
- [ ] `composer test:js` passes locally, if JavaScript changed.
- [ ] New PHP files start with `declare(strict_types=1);`.
- [ ] Content saved before the change still renders, or the break is called out (`feat!:` / `BREAKING CHANGE:`).
- [ ] The README is updated if behavior or configuration changed.
